description: Repository structure validation configuration. Can be extended or overridden via REPO_STRUCTURE_VALIDATION_CONFIG repository variable. NOTE: Scheduled runs automatically discover all private/internal repositories from the organization - this config is used only for manual workflow dispatch.
scheduledRunBehavior: Automatic organization repository discovery - validates all private/internal repos without manual configuration
validationModeNote: Used only for manual dispatch. Set to 'multiple-repos' (default) for multi-repo validation, or 'current-repo' to validate only this repository. Ignored for scheduled runs. Use target-repositories workflow input to specify repos.

comments.validationMode: Determine whether to validate only the current repo or a list of repos
comments.repositoriesToValidate: Array of repositories in owner/repo format to validate
comments.configPairsRequiringConsistency: These config pairs must match exactly between ref and sample directories
comments.configPairsWithCommentVariance: These config pairs may have variance in comments and examples, but core structure must match
